mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising (defined as HOUST > 1300 for two consecutive months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and reduces forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (HOUST>1300 and CPIAUCSL>255), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets generate wage pressures and inflation, leading the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising (defined as INDPRO > 108 for two consecutive months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust demand across the housing and manufacturing sectors, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods (HOUST>1300 and INDPRO>108), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the Federal Reserve's policy actions increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
